CategoryConfig.description:
`[category.<name>]`: settings shared by the sources that pick it.
`[category.default]` applies to every source.

cookies_file.description: Netscape cookies file, for private sources. "" = none.

cover_file.description:
The poster, a full path ending in .jpg, .png or .webp (which picks
the image format). Defaults to "{output_dir}/{normalized_title}-poster.jpg".

cutoff.description: Skip videos published before this: "30d", "2024-01-01" or "none".

embed.description: Metadata embedded in the media file.

exclude.description: Drop an item if any rule matches. Wins over include.

hooks.description: Hook names, run in order after each download.

include.description: Keep an item if any rule matches (empty = keep all).

inherit_hooks.description: Add hooks to the ones inherited instead of replacing them.

inherit_rules.description: Add include/exclude to the ones inherited (category, then `default`) instead of replacing them.

keep_raw_info.description: Keep yt-dlp's raw info JSON next to the metadata file (as `<metadata file name>.ytdlp.json`).

match_fields.description: Field(s) plain-string rules are tested against.

media_dir.description:
The media folder, a full path; path settings refer to it as {media_dir}.
Defaults to ~/.local/share/tidepool/media.

metadata_file.description: tidepool's metadata.json, a full path. Defaults to "{output_dir}/metadata.json".

output_dir.description:
Each video's directory, a full path; the file settings refer to it
as {output_dir}. Defaults to "{media_dir}/{source}/{upload_date} - {title} [{id}]".

output_file.description:
The media file, a full path; must contain {ext}.
Defaults to "{output_dir}/{normalized_title}.{ext}".

redownload_missing.description:
Restore a downloaded video's missing files (video, poster, subtitles,
metadata); otherwise each run reports them.

subtitle_file.description:
Each subtitle file, a full path; must contain {lang} and {ext}.
Defaults to "{output_dir}/{normalized_title}.{lang}.{ext}".

tmp_dir.description:
Work area for downloads in progress, a full path ({data_dir} and
{media_dir} allowed). Defaults to {data_dir}/tmp.

oneOf.description: Keep metadata.json and the cover, drop media and subtitles.

CleanupOptions.description: `cleanup`: limits that keep a mirror bounded.

keep.description: What to keep of a removed item.

keep_latest.description: Protect the newest N items from every other policy.

marker_file.description: Remove items whose video dir contains this file; "" = off.

max_age.description: Remove items older than this; "" = no limit.

max_items.description: Keep at most this many items; 0 = unlimited.

max_size.description: Remove oldest items until media fits; "" = no limit.

order.description: Who goes first for count, size and age limits.

removed_from_source.description: Videos no longer in the source (or no longer passing the rules).

managed.description: tidepool downloads Deno 2.x and keeps it updated.

path.description: Deno executable; only used when `managed = false`.

update_check.description: How often to look for a new release.

EmbedOptions.description: `embed`: what goes into the media file. Everything is off by default.

metadata.description: Title, channel, date, description, URL, album/track.

tags.description: Extra tags, literal or templated, e.g. `album_artist = "{channel}"`.

duplicates.description: What to do when the same video is in several sources.

regex_backtrack_limit.description: fancy-regex backtracking step limit per match.

shutdown_timeout.description: Grace period for child processes after SIGINT/SIGTERM.

HookConfig.description: A hook: a command run after a video is downloaded or before it is cleaned up.

command.description: argv array; `{placeholder}`s are expanded inside each element, no shell.

timeout.description: SIGTERM to the process group after this long, SIGKILL 10 s later.

type.description:
When the hook runs: `downloaded` (raw files, before embedding; may
replace them), `embed` (rewrites what gets embedded), `finished`
(after the files are in place) or `before_cleanup`.

work_dir.description: Working directory. Defaults to the video's directory.

oneOf.description: On the raw files in the work area, before embedding; may replace them.
Receives the data about to be embedded as JSON; returns it processed.
After the video's files are in place.
Before files are deleted; a non-zero exit vetoes the cleanup.
Stop the chain; the item becomes `hook_failed`.
Retry up to `retries` times, then fail.

anyOf.description: Regex (fancy-regex syntax) tested against every field in `match_fields`.
One field equal to a value, e.g. `{ field = "kind", value = "short" }`.

Rule.description:
An include/exclude rule: a regex tested against `match_fields`, a
`{ field, pattern }` table targeting one field, or a `{ field, value }`
table matching one field exactly.

RuleField.description:
A field rules can match against. `kind` (`video`, `short` or `live`)
only works with `{ field = "kind", value = … }`.

interval.description: Run sync + cleanup this often; "" = off.

enabled.description: Serve the web UI from `tidepool run --daemon`; false = sync daemon only.

listen.description: Address the web UI listens on, e.g. "127.0.0.1:8787".

read_only_config.description: Disable the config editor in the web UI.

token.description: Access token; required for a non-loopback `listen` address. "" = none.

SourceConfig.description: One source to keep in sync.

category.description: The category whose settings this source uses. Defaults to "default".

cookies_file.description: Netscape cookies file, for private sources. "" = none.

cover_file.description:
The poster, a full path ending in .jpg, .png or .webp (which picks
the image format). Defaults to "{output_dir}/{normalized_title}-poster.jpg".

cutoff.description: Skip videos published before this: "30d", "2024-01-01" or "none".

embed.description: Metadata embedded in the media file.

exclude.description: Drop an item if any rule matches. Wins over include.

hooks.description: Hook names, run in order after each download.

include.description: Keep an item if any rule matches (empty = keep all).

inherit_hooks.description: Add hooks to the ones inherited instead of replacing them.

inherit_rules.description: Add include/exclude to the ones inherited (category, then `default`) instead of replacing them.

keep_raw_info.description: Keep yt-dlp's raw info JSON next to the metadata file (as `<metadata file name>.ytdlp.json`).

match_fields.description: Field(s) plain-string rules are tested against.

media_dir.description:
The media folder, a full path; path settings refer to it as {media_dir}.
Defaults to ~/.local/share/tidepool/media.

metadata_file.description: tidepool's metadata.json, a full path. Defaults to "{output_dir}/metadata.json".

output_dir.description:
Each video's directory, a full path; the file settings refer to it
as {output_dir}. Defaults to "{media_dir}/{source}/{upload_date} - {title} [{id}]".

output_file.description:
The media file, a full path; must contain {ext}.
Defaults to "{output_dir}/{normalized_title}.{ext}".

redownload_missing.description:
Restore a downloaded video's missing files (video, poster, subtitles,
metadata); otherwise each run reports them.

subtitle_file.description:
Each subtitle file, a full path; must contain {lang} and {ext}.
Defaults to "{output_dir}/{normalized_title}.{lang}.{ext}".

tmp_dir.description:
Work area for downloads in progress, a full path ({data_dir} and
{media_dir} allowed). Defaults to {data_dir}/tmp.

url.description:
Where videos come from: a YouTube playlist URL (with `list=`) or a channel
URL (`/@handle`, `/channel/UC…`, `/c/name`, `/user/name`: all its uploads).

deno.description: Deno, the JavaScript runtime yt-dlp needs for YouTube.

yt-dlp.description: yt-dlp: managed by tidepool (default) or your own binary.

YoutubeOptions.description:
`youtube` in a category or source: YouTube Data API settings, merged key
by key like the other options.

api_key.description: YouTube Data API v3 key. Optional; without it, indexing uses yt-dlp only.

daily_quota.description: Daily quota of the key's Google Cloud project.

fallback_to_ytdlp.description: With an API key: use yt-dlp on quota exhaustion, a rejected key or repeated 5xx.

quota_warn_at.description: Warn when this fraction of `daily_quota` is used.

channel.description: Release channel for the managed binary.

managed.description: tidepool downloads yt-dlp and keeps it updated.

path.description: yt-dlp executable; only used when `managed = false`.

update_check.description: How often to look for a new release.

category.description:
Groups of settings sources pick with `category`; `default` applies to
every source, other categories on top of it.

general.description: Settings for the whole run: concurrency, duplicates, shutdown.

hooks.description: Named post-download hooks, attached to sources by name.

server.description: The web UI served by `tidepool run --daemon`.

sources.description: Sources to keep in sync, by name.

tools.description: The tools tidepool runs: yt-dlp and Deno.

version.description: Config format version. Optional; when set, must be 1.
